headerDisplay: Homebridge plugin for Sensibo - Smart AC Control
footerDisplay: Created by @nitaybz, maintained by volunteers, please consider a ☆ on GitHub if you find it useful!

apiKey.title: API Key
apiKey.description: An API Key can be used instead of username/password, to create a Sensibo API key visit https://home.sensibo.com/me/api

modesToExclude.title: Air Conditioning Modes to Exclude
modesToExclude.description: Select the AC modes you want removed from your AC Accessories in the Home app (leave empty to keep all available modes)

allowRepeatedCommands.title: Allow Repeated Commands
allowRepeatedCommands.description: Allow the plugin to send the same state command again

carbonDioxideAlertThreshold.title: Carbon Dioxide (CO2) Alert Threshold
carbonDioxideAlertThreshold.description: Value, in PPM, over which the Apple Home app will alert you to high CO2 readings.  Default is 1500. Requires the Carbon Dioxide Sensor be enabled and a compatible device

disableAirQuality.title: Disable Air Quality Sensor
disableAirQuality.description: Remove Air Quality and TVOC readings

disableDry.title: Disable Dry Accessory
disableDry.description: *Deprecated* Remove dehumidifier (dry) mode from ACs. Use Modes to Exclude (above) instead

disableFan.title: Disable Fan Accessory
disableFan.description: *Deprecated* Remove fan mode from ACs. Use Modes to Exclude (above) instead

disableHumidity.title: Disable Humidity Sensor
disableHumidity.description: Remove Humidity readings. Note: humidity will still show if you have Dry mode enabled

disableVerticalSwing.title: Disable Vertical Swing
disableVerticalSwing.description: Remove vertical swing (Oscillate) control switch from accessory

climateReactSwitchInAccessory.title: Climate React Switch in AC Accessory
climateReactSwitchInAccessory.description: Show the Climate React (Smart mode) switch in ACs (only works when `enableClimateReactSwitch` is set to true)

climateReactAsAutoMode.title: Use Climate React as the AUTO mode
climateReactAsAutoMode.description: Back the HomeKit AUTO mode with Climate React (Smart mode) instead of the AC's native AUTO. In AUTO nothing is sent to the AC - Climate React alone switches it on/off, so the fan stops between cycles. The AUTO temperature range sets the Climate React low/high thresholds. Switching to COOL or OFF disables Climate React. Exclude HEAT from the modes when using this.

climateReactAutoLowOffset.title: AUTO low threshold offset (°C)
climateReactAutoLowOffset.description: Added to the LOW threshold sent to Climate React only, so HomeKit 23 becomes 23.2 in Climate React. The high threshold is never offset. Default 0.2.

climateReactAutoTargetTemperature.title: AUTO: AC setpoint while cooling (°C)
climateReactAutoTargetTemperature.description: The temperature Climate React commands on the AC when it switches the unit on in AUTO. Independent of the AUTO range: the range decides when the AC runs, this decides how hard it cools. Clamped to what the AC supports. Default 22.

climateReactAutoFanLevel.title: AUTO: fan level while cooling
climateReactAutoFanLevel.description: The fan level Climate React commands on the AC when it switches the unit on in AUTO. Falls back to the current fan level if the AC doesn't support the chosen one. Default low.

climateReactAutoTemperatureStep.title: AUTO: temperature range step (°C)
climateReactAutoTemperatureStep.description: Step for the HomeKit AUTO range. Climate React thresholds are triggers rather than AC setpoints, so they can be finer than the whole degrees the AC accepts - 0.5 allows ranges like 23.5-24.5. Commands sent to the AC itself are still rounded to a whole degree. Celsius only. Default 1.

climateReactAutoMinTemperature.title: AUTO: minimum selectable temperature (°C)
climateReactAutoMinTemperature.description: Narrows the bottom of the temperature slider in the Home app, so you don't have to drag through temperatures you'd never use. Ignored if lower than what the AC supports. Only used when 'climateReactAsAutoMode' is enabled.

climateReactAutoMaxTemperature.title: AUTO: maximum selectable temperature (°C)
climateReactAutoMaxTemperature.description: Narrows the top of the temperature slider in the Home app. Ignored if higher than what the AC supports. Only used when 'climateReactAsAutoMode' is enabled.

climateReactAutoDebounceMs.title: Climate React update debounce (ms)
climateReactAutoDebounceMs.description: How long to wait after the last change before sending the Climate React update. Coalesces the burst of updates HomeKit sends when dragging the AUTO range, avoiding rate-limit (429) errors. Default 3000.

enableClimateReactAutoSetup.title: Enable Climate React Auto Setup
enableClimateReactAutoSetup.description: Auto-update the Climate React (Smart mode) configuration to align whenever the AC state is set or changed

enableHistoryStorage.title: Enable History Storage
enableHistoryStorage.description: Record temperature & humidity measurements over time, viewable as History in the Eve app

enableOccupancySensor.title: Enable Occupancy Sensor
enableOccupancySensor.description: Add occupancy sensor to represent the state of someone at home/away

enableSyncButton.title: Enable Sync Switch
enableSyncButton.description: Add a switch to toggle the state of the AC, without sending commands to the unit

syncButtonInAccessory.title: Sync Button in AC Accessory
syncButtonInAccessory.description: Show the AC Sync switch in accessory

ignoreHomeKitDevices.title: Ignore HomeKit Devices
ignoreHomeKitDevices.description: Automatically ignore, skip or remove HomeKit supported devices

devicesToExclude.title: Devices to Exclude (Name/ID/Serial)
devicesToExclude.description: Add device identifiers (Name, ID from logs or serial from Home app) to exclude them from homebridge

locationsToInclude.title: Device Locations to Include
locationsToInclude.description: Add device location IDs or names to include when discovering Sensibo devices (leave empty for all locations)

debug.title: Enable Debug Logs
debug.description: Enable extra logging for debugging purposes
